_comment: Hand-maintained pending actions merged into pending-actions.json by build-pending-actions.py. Scraped [data-webmaster] notes live on the pages themselves; put site-wide or cross-page issues here. Delete an entry when resolved and re-run the builder.

entries.title: Navigation label: confirm the two remaining 'High Power' labels

notes.text: DONE 2026-08-13: the 'High Power/Current Pulsers' group heading in the Application Briefs and Technical Notes dropdowns now reads 'High Voltage/Current Pulsers' on all 668 pages that carry the nav (337 were already switched; the remaining 331 were completed in one scripted pass). STILL OPEN, needs David: two other labels still say 'High Power' and were deliberately left alone pending confirmation - (1) the top Products menu item, 'High Power/Current Pulsers & Supplies', and (2) the Support > Product Documentation link label, 'High Power/Current Pulsers'. Both are consistent across all 668 pages today, so they can be flipped in one pass whenever you say. The /dei-home.html page heading and title are a separate question again.

entries.title: DEI High Power/Current Pulsers line page

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the page's previous meta description claimed 300 kV, but the page content says 30 kV max for DC supplies. Confirm the correct top-line voltage for the DEI line; the new meta avoids the number until engineering confirms.

entries.title: Model 645 AWG: datasheet vs AWG index conflict

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the Model 645 datasheet page says 14-bit, 50 MHz; the AWG product-index card says 16-bit, 20 MHz. One of them is wrong. Reconcile against the current published 645 datasheet PDF and fix whichever page disagrees.

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the 745T datasheet page states 1 ps resolution while the user-manual page states about 0.25 ps. Confirm the published spec and align both pages.

SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the PVX-4150 source PDF shows plus/minus 1,500 V while a listing shows plus/minus 15 kV. Confirm the correct rating with engineering before either figure is used in marketing copy.

SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the 871 manual page contains conflicting frequency-range statements in different sections. The new meta description avoids a range claim; reconcile the manual content against the current 871 datasheet.

entries.title: HVX HV power supply: 'manual' URL serves a datasheet

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08: this URL is named hv-power-supply-manual but the page content is a datasheet. Rename the file (with a redirect) or swap in the actual manual content so the URL matches what visitors and search engines see.

entries.title: Rewrite the ICX USB/LAN manuals as BNC documents, then restore the PDF downloads

notes.text: OPEN 2026-08-19, needs engineering + marketing. The three downloadable ICX USB/LAN manual PDFs were the original supplier documents, unmodified: supplier logo on the cover, supplier wordmark silkscreened on the product photos, and the supplier's own model numbers throughout. Two of the three were byte-identical and served under two different BNC filenames. They have been withdrawn from the site (files deleted, pdf-map entries removed, and the three PDF URLs 301 to their HTML manual pages), so no customer can download a supplier-branded document today. The HTML manuals themselves are fully rebranded and stay live. What is still needed: re-issue each manual as a genuine BNC document (BNC cover, BNC model numbers, product photography without the supplier wordmark, SpectraCore screenshots relabelled), then add the new PDFs back to docs/pdfs/ and re-register them in docs/pdfs/pdf-map.json so the download line and hero button return. Affected: bnc-icx-series-usb-lan-manual.html (was bnc-icx-fieldhawk-usb-san-manual.html and bnc-icx-usb-lan-san-nx-manual.html, now merged) and bnc-icx-series-usb-lan-20ghz-manual.html (was bnc-icx-usb-lan-sae-nxe-manual.html). verify.

OPEN 2026-08-19, needs engineering. Two model-coverage gaps remain after the all-models restore. (1) bnc-icx-fieldhawk-usb-datasheet.html has no ICX-045U row or column: its spec values were never recorded in the hidden markup, so they must come from the source datasheet rather than be inferred. (2) The ICX-090R to ICX-095R rename from 2026-08-13 is only half applied across the site, so the rugged line is described inconsistently. Confirm which name is current and it can be swept in one pass. verify.
